verdicts.reason: Both break the key image: the cream circle is pulled away from the Solstice can and left as a meaningless blob in the bottom-right corner. A keeps a readable logo (bottom-left), a prominent NEW VIDEO badge and a strong headline, but leaves the can small and floating. B shrinks the logo until it is almost invisible and jams it onto the circle's lower edge. B's can also partly clips the circle by accident, and its badge is small and pushed into the corner.
